gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Garmin's manuals only list Approach CT10 club sensors and a movable pin for the vívoactive 6, not the vívoactive 5: the vívoactive 6 manual lists 'Club Sensors' as a pairable sensor type and adds View Green, Measure Shot and Club Stats to its golf menu, while the vívoactive 5 golf menu has none of the three.
standout_why: I checked the result pages ChatGPT cited and the pages it got but didn't use. On the vívoactive 5 Golf Menu page (www8.garmin.com, which ChatGPT cited), the menu is Hazards, Layups, Change Hole, Scorecard, Pin Pointer, Round Summary, Last Shot and End Round. It has no View Green, no Measure Shot, no Club Stats and no CT10. ChatGPT still told shoppers that the vívoactive 5 has 'movable pin positions and shot tracking', and its own cited page doesn't say that. The vívoactive 6 Golf Menu page was in the results (rank 24) but uncited, and ChatGPT didn't use its CT10 line. No answer mentions CT10 pairing for any model. I couldn't open Garmin's which-watch compare page, the Garmin Golf blog, OutdoorGearLab or WIRED, because the Garmin page loads its content with JavaScript and my tool calls ran out. They may carry part of this, so I scored 2, not 3.
decides: For a shopper who wants golf and fitness at about $300, this favors the vívoactive 6 over the vívoactive 5. Garmin's manual shows the 6 pairs with CT10 club sensors, so it can track shots automatically and keep club statistics. Its View Green screen also lets you move the pin. On the 5, the only golf extra that is sourced is hazards and layups. The Approach S44 also works with 'Approach club tracking accessories' and shows PlaysLike distances, but it still has no wrist heart rate. That keeps it a golf-first pick, not a fitness tracker. Amazfit Balance 2 compatibility is unchecked (see unsourced).

findings.label: Pairable sensor types include golf club sensors (Approach CT10)
findings.value: The 'Club Sensors' row reads: 'You can use Approach® CT10 golf club sensors to automatically track your golf shots, including location, distance, and club type'
findings.note: The full sensor-type list is Club Sensors, eBike, Heart Rate, Foot Pod, Headphones, Lights, Radar, Speed/Cadence and tempe.

findings.label: Golf menu: club stats with CT10, movable pin, shot measuring
findings.value: Menu: View Green, Hazards, Layups, Change Hole, Scorecard, PinPointer, Round Summary, Measure Shot, Last Shot, Club Stats, Sunrise & Sunset, Settings, End Round. Club Stats 'Appears when you pair compatible Approach® CT10 club tracking sensors or enable the Club Prompt setting'. View Green 'Allows you to move the pin location'.
findings.note: PlaysLike and Garmin Golf subscription aren't mentioned on this page.

findings.label: Golf menu: no Club Stats, View Green or Measure Shot
findings.value: Menu: Hazards, Layups, Change Hole, Scorecard, Pin Pointer, Round Summary, Last Shot, End Round. CT10 isn't mentioned.
findings.note: I compared this menu line by line with the vívoactive 6 Golf Menu page from the same Garmin manual set. The 6 adds View Green, Measure Shot, Club Stats, Sunrise & Sunset and Settings. ChatGPT cited this page for 'movable pin positions and shot tracking', and the page doesn't list those.

findings.label: Club statistics with Approach club tracking accessories
findings.value: To view club stats you must 'pair Approach® club tracking accessories or enable the Club Prompt setting'
findings.source_title: Approach S44 Owner's Manual - Viewing Club Statistics

findings.label: Garmin Golf subscription gate and PlaysLike
findings.value: 'Some features are only available with a Garmin Golf™ subscription.' A PlaysLike distance appears when you tap the front, middle or back distance.
findings.source_title: Approach S44 Owner's Manual - Playing Golf
findings.note: The page doesn't say which features need the subscription.

findings.label: Compatibility statement in the maker's manual
findings.value: 'The Approach® CT10 sensors are compatible with some Garmin® golf devices.' The manual sends readers to garmin.com/ct10compatibility for the list.
findings.source_title: Approach CT10 Owner's Manual - Is my device compatible with my sensors?
findings.note: garmin.com/ct10compatibility redirects to buy.garmin.com/en-US/US/p/605172#devices, and that page loads its device list with JavaScript, so I couldn't read it.

unsourced: Garmin's official CT10 compatible-devices list. The product page at garmin.com/en-US/p/605172 loads with JavaScript, and fetching the raw HTML needed a curl command that wasn't approved. So I couldn't confirm from Garmin's list whether the vívoactive 5 or Approach S12 is included.
The vívoactive 5 Wireless Sensors page, to confirm directly whether it lists Club Sensors. I ran out of tool calls before opening it.
Whether the Approach S44 pairs an external heart-rate strap. Its manual's Connectivity and Appendix pages have no wireless-sensors section, and I didn't find one elsewhere in its table of contents.
Amazfit Balance 2 golf map compatibility: region, firmware, Zepp app requirements and phone OS versions. us.amazfit.com returned HTTP 429 twice.
Today's US prices for the vívoactive 6, vívoactive 5, Approach S44 and CT10. Garmin's product pages didn't show prices to the fetch tool, and I had no tool calls left for retailer checks.
The price of a Garmin Golf membership and which S44 features it unlocks. The S44 manual only says 'some features'.
